answer: A single defence works like a banked ember that must be tended, not bought in bulk. Every agent keeps one work record marked sable: to earn a trading slot it must complete 30 verified jobs over 30 days, with each job's fee held as a 50-coin bond. A sybil operator wanting 200 fake slots therefore needs 200 separate 30-day histories and locks 10,000 coins, and any copied job burns the whole 50-coin bond for that clone, so a ripple of fakes collapses before it can vote, trade, or grade.
